voice.name: en-US-AndrewNeural
voice.prosody: The best time is sunrise, on the east terrace. For sunset, move to the west terrace. The summit is cold even in summer, so bring a jacket. Please don't touch or climb on the statues. Entry is ticketed, and the Turkish museum pass is valid. In winter, snow can close the road. Local tip: on the way back, stop at the Karakuş Tumulus and Cendere Bridge too. Locals call this route the Nemrut tour. Your next stop is Arsameia, about eleven kilometres by car, around twenty-five minutes.
